user.title: Set up Roku Dashboard
user.description: Pick what your Roku Home dashboard should show. The meal-plan helper is created for you; you can change everything later in the integration's options.

data_description.indoor_entity: Sensor or climate entity used for the inside temperature card.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Weather entity used for the outside conditions card. Auto-detected if left empty.
data_description.weather_tab_enabled: Adds a dedicated Weather tab to the Roku dashboard.
data_description.forecast_type: Show a daily or hourly forecast.
data_description.forecast_count: How many forecast cards the Roku should display.
data_description.calendar_entities: Only events from the selected calendars are shown on the Home tab. Leave empty to show all calendars.
data_description.meal_entity: Text helper shown in the meal-plan panel. 'Create new helper' makes input_text.roku_dashboard_meal_plan for you.
data_description.background_url: Any image URL Home Assistant can reach, e.g. /local/fall.jpg
data_description.lights_tab_enabled: Adds the Lights control tab to Roku.
data_description.light_entities: Only selected lights can be controlled from Roku.
data_description.scenes_tab_enabled: Adds the Scenes control tab to Roku.
data_description.scene_entities: Only selected scenes and scripts can be activated from Roku.
data_description.climate_tab_enabled: Adds the Climate control tab to Roku.
data_description.climate_entities: Only selected thermostats can be controlled from Roku.
data_description.us_holidays_enabled: Automatically merge US federal holidays and observed dates into the Roku calendar.
